key.name: layout
key.description: The layout last applied with redfox-layout. Informational; changing it does nothing by itself.

key.name: floating-dock
key.description: Detach Dash to Dock from the screen edge by floating-dock-gap pixels.

key.name: floating-dock-gap
key.summary: Gap between the floating dock and the screen edge, in pixels

key.name: auto-dock
key.summary: Switch between the dock and the GNOME dash by screen size
key.description: Turn Dash to Dock on when the primary monitor is at least auto-dock-min-width logical pixels wide, and off (leaving GNOME's own dash in the overview) on smaller screens.

key.name: auto-dock-min-width
key.summary: Smallest primary monitor width (logical pixels) that gets the dock
